scope: Only the 16 d=1 StageA2 factor branches whose A*B pair quotient has one of the two PARI-certified rank-zero Jacobians. This lock does not classify the other 76 branches.

logic: Each quartic is smooth and has four explicit distinct rational points with Y=0 at its four rational linear-factor roots.
The degree-four leading coefficient is a negative rational square, so there is no rational projective point at infinity.

A smooth genus-one curve with a rational point is Q-isomorphic as a torsor to its Jacobian after choosing that point as origin; hence its Q-point set has the same cardinality as the Jacobian Q-point group.
The prior PARI classification certifies rank zero. The execution attached to this lock must additionally certify Jacobian torsion order exactly 4 using PARI elltors.
Therefore each quotient quartic has exactly four rational points, namely the four displayed branch points.
pointset_theorem.required_PARl_semantics: ellrank interval [0,0] and elltors total torsion order 4 on each exact locked short Weierstrass model

pullback_rule.complete: Test all four quotient Q-points against all four exact squareclass equations of every one of the 16 parent branches.
pullback_rule.no_lift: If no quotient point satisfies all four squareclass equations, the parent branch has no Q-point.
pullback_rule.torsion_lift: If a quotient branch point lifts, then A=0 gives x=-1 and B=0 gives x=-q^2. These are roots of x(x+1)(x+q^2), hence rational 2-torsion on E_q and have zero free part.
pullback_rule.receiver_scope: The authoritative Stage34 population contains only nonzero free-lattice points n*P_q+T with n>=1, or nonzero rank-two lattice coordinates plus torsion. Pure torsion points are outside R29-EXT-CHANG-C population credit.

credit: A successful execution may close only these 16 parent factor branches for the audited non-torsion receiver population. It does not close the remaining 76 d=1 branches, the direct cover, all multiples, R29-EXT-CHANG-C, any parent route, or the perfect-cuboid problem.
